g.title: U1
g.text: GPIO41 (I2S SCK, shared with U9 BCLK)
GPIO42 (I2S WS, shared with U9 LRC)

FUTURE ONLY - not installed. Only the pins used by future provisions are shown here. GPIO41/42 and GPIO47/21 are already wired today (see peripherals.yml and i2c.yml); this file shows the same nodes tapped for the future parts below.

g.title: W_U1_U10_SCK
g.text: U1:GPIO41:GPIO41 (I2S SCK, shared with U9 BCLK)
FUTURE - not installed. Shared with U9 BCLK.

g.title: W_U1_U10_WS
g.text: U1:GPIO42:GPIO42 (I2S WS, shared with U9 LRC)
FUTURE - not installed. Shared with U9 LRC.

g.title: W_MUX_A0
g.text: FUTURE - not installed. Sets mux address 0x71.

g.title: U10
g.text: FUTURE - NOT INSTALLED (DESIGN.md X-2). 3.3 V, less than 2 mA. Shares SCK/WS with the installed MAX98357A on one full-duplex I2S port. Does not use the microSD slot (GPIO40 is its data line).

g.title: W_U10_LR
g.text: FUTURE - not installed. L/R tied to GND (left channel).

g.title: TCA9548A
g.text: FUTURE - NOT INSTALLED (DESIGN.md X-3). Address 0x71: A0 tied to 3.3V, A1/A2 tied to GND. Sits on the main I2C bus alongside the devices in i2c.yml. 0x70 is avoided (PCA9685 all-call).

g.title: EYE_L
g.text: FUTURE - NOT INSTALLED (DESIGN.md X-3). I2C 0x3C, on mux channel 0 (SD0/SC0).

g.title: EYE_R
g.text: FUTURE - NOT INSTALLED (DESIGN.md X-3). I2C 0x3C, on mux channel 1 (SD1/SC1).
